Title: Credential lifecycle
Description: Demo control: credentials are issued, rotated, and revoked through a documented process. Initial secrets are changed on first use.

Title: Access approval
Description: Demo control: human access is granted only after an approval distinct from the requester. Changes are recorded.

Title: Joiner-mover-leaver
Description: Demo control: access is removed when people leave or change role. Stale accounts are reviewed on a schedule.

Title: Password policy
Description: Demo control: passwords have a documented minimum length and lockout after repeated failures. Reuse of recent passwords is blocked.

Title: Runtime authentication
Description: Demo control: applications authenticate the caller and check authorization when a session is established.

Title: Just-in-time privilege
Description: Demo control: standing admin rights are avoided. Elevated access is time-bounded and tied to a ticket or change.

Title: Break-glass access
Description: Demo control: emergency access is rare, dual-controlled, logged, and reviewed after use.

Title: Role definitions
Description: Demo control: roles are documented per asset with purpose and restrictions. Unused roles are retired.

Title: Infrastructure scanning
Description: Demo control: hosts and images are scanned for known vulnerabilities. Findings are tracked to closure.

Title: Web application scanning
Description: Demo control: internet-facing apps are scanned on a defined cadence. Gaps are recorded.

Title: Penetration testing
Description: Demo control: periodic adversary-style tests exercise critical paths. Findings are remediated or accepted.

Title: Traffic monitoring
Description: Demo control: network telemetry is collected, reviewed, and escalated when malicious patterns appear.

Title: Secure development testing
Description: Demo control: source and dependencies are tested for common flaws before release.

Title: Security monitoring
Description: Demo control: attacks such as flooding, malware, and intrusion attempts are monitored and triaged.

Title: Insider-risk monitoring
Description: Demo control: unusual use of privileged access is reviewed. This is a demo statement, not a workplace program.

Title: Incident response
Description: Demo control: there is a written process to contain, eradicate, and recover from security incidents.

Title: External threat watch
Description: Demo control: public threat reporting is reviewed and assigned an owner when relevant.

Title: Unauthorized device detection
Description: Demo control: unexpected devices on the network are flagged for investigation.

Title: Malware protection
Description: Demo control: endpoints run maintained malware protection. Failures are treated as incidents.
